title: Astrid and the Playlist
author: Silas Fairweather
blurb: Ansel Eastwick, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
